decisions.statement: A line is appended beside a page that is there and nowhere else.
A path naming no page here is refused rather than given a file of its own.
An append names the part it is kept under, and entries is the part it falls back to.
Every line appended ends with a newline.
The lines of one append land together or land nowhere.
A part filled to its ceiling rolls to the next part.
An append takes a turn over the first part before any line lands.
An append that took no turn is refused rather than waited on.
An answer names the file part the lines landed in.

definition: lines added to the end of a file part a page keeps outside the commit
